integrity: Exhaustive finite classification is reduced to the 22 partitions of eight and checked by the standalone exact-integer program; no sampling or numerical extrapolation is used. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proven for full multiplicity-sensitive substring-composition observations at source length eight and all finite alphabets of size at least two; not a general-length or noisy-channel result. General interleaving and the first binary example are prior work; priority of this exact all-alphabet census has not been independently established.
title: Complete length-eight substring-composition spectra on arbitrary alphabets
